units.source_text: 就在夫人、小姐和我的关系到了这个程度的时候，另一个男人不可避免地插了进来。

en.t: Just when my relationship with the madam and her daughter had reached this point, another man inevitably entered the scene.

units.source_text: 他成为这个家庭的一员后，给我的命运带来了巨大的变化。

en.t: After he became a member of this household, he brought a tremendous change to my fate.

units.source_text: 倘若没有他闯入我的生活轨道的话，恐怕就没有必要给你写这封长长的遗书了。

en.t: If he had not broken into the course of my life, I probably would not have needed to write you this long testament.

units.source_text: 这就好像我轻易站在魔鬼通过的路上，却没有意识到那瞬间的黑影将使我的一生变得暗淡无光。

en.t: It was as though I had carelessly stood in the path of a demon, unaware that the shadow of that instant would darken my whole life.

units.source_text: 坦白地说，是我自己硬把他拉到这个家里来的。

en.t: To be honest, I was the one who forced him into this house.

units.source_text: 当然这需要夫人同意才行，所以一开始我就没有隐瞒他的情况，请夫人同意他搬进来，但是，夫人说‘不好吧’。

en.t: Of course, this required the madam's consent, so from the beginning I hid nothing about him and asked her to let him move in, but she said, 'That would not be good.'

units.source_text: 我觉得让他搬来的理由很充分，反倒是夫人完全没有不同意的道理。

en.t: I felt there were ample reasons to let him move in, while the madam had no real reason at all to object.

units.source_text: 于是，我坚持自己的主张，自行其是地让他搬了进来。

en.t: So I insisted on my own view and, acting on my own judgment, had him move in.
